newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat does not trade, stays supported by pool.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat does not trade, stays supported by pool.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures remained stuck in a lethargic mode on Tuesday, with settlement prices steady.

Ed Scamps, of Elders Risk Management Pty Ltd, said the Australian Wheat Board pool price and the strong rise in Chicago overnight were helping support the market, as was an expected decline in area sown to wheat with increased canola plantings.
Some signs of grower hedging were emerging as farmers prepared to put the new crop in. This may dampen the market slightly, he said.
But the market simply remained fundamentally quiet, he said.
